scope: Fixed-source local Python worker compatibility under production CSP; excludes actual Monaco typing, final scene/deck acceptance and Office playback.
wrapper_rule: Unmodified source bytes; set __name__ to bypass the CLI-only entry, then train() or train(learning_rate=0.0) as the final Python expression.
timing_observation: New Python VM per run; loading/running/done DOM intervals include UI scheduling. Total worker elapsed spans creation through result receipt. Browser HTTP caching was disabled for the isolated check.
returned_result_hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JavaScript JSON.stringify(full returned dictionary)

production_csp.server_mode: isolated loopback HTTP using release interactive_server
